name: dar-alef-new
description: Dar Al-Alef factory system - clean V2 (node:http, zero deps)

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let n=0;function w(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name==='node_modules'||e.name==='.git')continue;w(p);}else if(/\.bak(-.*)?$|\.tmp$/.test(e.name)){fs.unlinkSync(p);n++;}}}w(__dirname);w(path.join(__dirname,'..','frontend'));console.log('cleaned '+n+' files')"
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check src/auth.js && node --check src/master.js && node --check scripts/backup-data.js
